meta.source: L2J High Five datapack quest Java (Shagooh/l2j-server-datapack main) + spawns_h5/teleports_h5. Manual step order for the team quests (64,65,66,211,212,214,215,217,219,220,223,226,227,229,233); summary order for the rest (213,216,218,221,222,224,225,228,230,231,232).

model.soloFeasibility: With free Community Board buffs (~20-28 incl. Might/Shield/Haste/Acumen/Berserker/Wind Walk) at lvl 35-40. no = quest boss/party flag or 2+ steps with lvl 42+ mobs; risky = one lvl 42+ step or 2+ lvl 40-41 steps.
model.effort: raw = kills*0.35 + hops*1.5 + walkKm*0.8 + SoE*2 + adena/8000 + places*1.2 + talks*0.3 + 7 per dangerous step + 4 per low-chance step + weapon 6 / skill 8 / spawn 4 / timed 3 / boss 3 / party 6 / adena-fee 4; scaled 0-100 against the hardest.
